resources.string: Record the steps that caused a problem
Collect page visits, operations and available error evidence on this phone. Review the report before sharing it.
1. Turn on collection.\n2. Return to the app and reproduce the problem.\n3. Turn it off, then choose a saved report to send.
Reports stay on this phone until you choose to share. Collection does not intentionally capture photos or text you enter. Check report contents before sending.
Turn it on when you need to reproduce a problem. Saved reports remain available below.
Return to the app to reproduce the problem. The floating indicator brings you back here.
Could not read saved reports. Retry without deleting your files.
Could not prepare the attachment. Your saved record is retained. Free storage if needed, then retry.
The saved record and its cached attachment will be removed from this phone.
This report is no longer available. Return to saved reports.
Saved records remain until you delete them. If storage is full, delete reports you no longer need before starting another collection.
Deletion did not complete. Return to saved reports to check or retry.
